Class TableEdit<T>

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.table.AbstractTableModel
TableEdit<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, TableModel
public abstract class TableEdit<T> extends AbstractTableModel
Table model with one editable number in column 1 and "Unsaved" as the last column. Edits wait in pending (id -> new value) until saved.
